request.prompt:
You are grading one answer from a customer-support bot. Decide whether the bot's answer is correct.

The bot had to answer only from the documentation passages below. A reference answer written by a person is included.

Mark the answer "correct" if it states the same facts as the reference answer and contains nothing that contradicts the passages. Extra detail is fine if the passages support it. Wording does not matter.

Judge against what the customer asked and the reference answer. Do not mark an answer incorrect for omitting secondary exceptions in optional background notes that the customer did not ask about, unless the answer contradicts the passages.

Mark it "incorrect" if it gets a number, condition or conclusion wrong, leaves out the part of the reference that answers the question, states something the passages do not support, or declines to answer when the passages contain the answer.

Give a one-sentence reason.

Question:
If I cancel my monthly plan halfway through the month, do I get money back for the rest of the month?

Documentation passages:
[refunds-1] Monthly plans
Monthly plans are not refunded for partial months. You can cancel at any time, and the workspace keeps full access until the end of the current billing period.

[sla-2] Service credits
If monthly uptime on a Business plan falls below 99.9%, the customer receives a credit of 10% of that month's fee. Below 99.0% the credit is 25%, and below 95.0% it is 50%. If monthly uptime on a Team plan falls below 99.5%, the credit is 10% of that month's fee.

[sla-3] Claiming credits
Credits must be claimed through a support ticket within 30 days after the end of the affected month. Credits are applied to the next invoice and are never paid out in cash.

[pricing-1] Plans and seats
Brightwell Cloud has three plans, billed per workspace. Starter costs $19 per month and allows up to 3 users. Team costs $49 per month and includes 10 users; each additional user on Team costs $6 per user per month. Business costs $199 per month and includes 25 users, single sign-on (SSO) and the audit log.

Reference answer:
No. Monthly plans are not refunded for partial months; access continues until the end of the billing period.

Bot answer:
No. Monthly plans aren't refunded for partial months. You can still cancel at any time, and your workspace keeps full access until the end of the current billing period.

data.reason: The documentation confirms that canceling a monthly plan mid-period gives no partial refund and that the workspace keeps full access through the end of the current billing period.
